source.content: Account a1 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object'); Account a2 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object'); insert new List<Account>{a1, a2}; List<SObject> list1 = new List<SObject>{a1, a2}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(list1).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.undelete(list1).size()); Account a3 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Boolean'); Account a4 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Boolean'); insert new List<Account>{a3, a4}; List<SObject> list2 = new List<SObject>{a3, a4}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(list2, false).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.undelete(list2, false).size()); Account a6 = new Account(Name = 'Undelete Object'); insert a6; SObject object2 = a6; delete a6; System.assert(Database.undelete(object2).isSuccess()); Account a7 = new Account(Name = 'Undelete Object Boolean'); insert a7; SObject object3 = a7; delete a7; System.assert(Database.undelete(object3, false).isSuccess());
